full_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver ONE square transparent PNG miniature token for Tales of Maj'Eyal: copperhead snake. Request 1024 x 1024 pixels; retain the tool's native resolution and alpha.

Identity brief: One complete copperhead viper with a distinctly broad copper-colored triangular head, narrow neck and tapering tail. Its body makes a loose open double bend like an offset S, rather than closing into a circle; head low and forward at lower left, tail curving toward upper left.
Family separation: Existing brown snake is a thick round closed coil with central dark hole and near-uniform warm brown body. Copperhead must read as a longer, more open serpentine diagonal with separated head and tail; broad bright copper head and darker deep-russet body create a different large-value pattern. Avoid a rattlesnake rattle or cobra hood.
Composition: One entire animal on one thin disc. Keep head, tail and every bend inside rim; open disc gap between separated body turns. Leave upper-right UI margin free of head. Scale the wedge head large enough to remain apparent at 48px, without exaggerating into a dragon head.

Match the designated style reference's steep overhead three-quarter camera, upper-left soft light, matte painted miniature finish and thin charcoal-brown physical disc with a restrained bronze-grey bevel. The disc occupies about 82% of the canvas width. All anatomy and equipment must remain inside it, with a clear margin. Use broad readable value planes and a crisp silhouette at 48/64/96px; dark bodies need a broad pale rim or lighter facing plane, not tiny glowing outlines. Keep identity-defining features out of the upper-right rank area and upper-left interaction-marker area. Native references establish identity; they do not override the style reference's camera or disc. Do not copy another species from a style reference.

Palette/material: Copper-orange head, deep reddish-brown body, muted pale tan broad hourglass saddles and underbelly. Matte natural scales with restrained highlights. No fangs as a separate status symbol, poison cloud, liquid or green glow.
True transparent alpha outside the disc; no painted checkerboard. Keep the entire disc in frame and transparent corners. This is a static identity illustration. Add no faction ring, health arc, shield, rank, crown, UI marker, number, text, aura, scene or floor outside the disc. No recolor-only substitute for a different species, no montage and no alternate variants in one image. Anatomy must match the identity brief, including intentional missing limbs.

Reference roles:
Image 1: style — Use the approved high three-quarter overhead camera, matte sculpted fur, dark physical disc and muted copper-grey rim; do not copy its body or tail pose.
Image 2: identity — Native copper head and reddish brown serpent, not body pose or effects.
Image 3: family — Existing brown snake: avoid its thick closed circular coil and similar overall warm-brown value.
